messages:
Maya Lopez: FYI — Peregrine renewal. Procurement asks to swap a 10% invoice discount for an "onboarding assistance" credit (services + two enablement sessions) applied to the renewal invoice. They say adoption slippage is the issue.
Tom Rivera: Onboarding snapshot: SSO cert problem + no bulk seat import. Only ~45% of seats live; adoption of key flow ~30%.
Samir Khatri: Product note: We can scope a CSV seat-mapping import. L0 estimate ~8 dev days + 2 QA days. If we start now, target ship 3 weeks.
Maya Lopez: Procurement prefers credit on-invoice (not separate SOW) and wants credit value visible on invoice line for their accounting.
AJ Patel: Finance: OK to apply a services credit on invoice if we add Delivery & Acceptance gating (recording, attendee list, signed checklist) and make it non-refundable. Need guardrail to avoid revenue deferral — propose either a 6-mo minimum spend or tie credit to immediate delivery.
Tom Rivera: We should require acceptance checklist template and PO line referencing the credit. Ops 3 ops-bot: can we surface invoice line and gate on checklist?
ops-bot: Confirmed. We can show the credit as invoice line if procurement supplies PO referencing credit line. Credit applied after signed acceptance checklist processed.
Maya Lopez: Legal: recordings and demoing customer data — any red flags? @legal-bot
legal-bot: Recordings and demo data require explicit consent. I'll draft a short "Training Recording & Data Use" addendum and a one-paragraph "Services Credit Acceptance" clause. ETA EOD.
Samir Khatri: Product asks we commit to CSV ship date in the amendment if we want procurement to forgo extension. If we miss date, procurement will ask for a 3-month prorate instead. Suggest include a fallback: if delivery > X days late then prorate applies.
AJ Patel: I'll model two financial scenarios (A: credit + CSV delivered; B: 3-month prorate). Share by EOD.
Maya Lopez: I'll hold countersign until legal addendum + finance guardrails are added. If both approve, I'll send amendment with: credit scope, deliverables (recording, attendee list, acceptance checklist), PO requirement, CSV commitment + fallback, and request countersignature. :thumbsup:
Tom Rivera: Also suggest scheduling tentative trainer dates now to avoid availability issues.
Maya Lopez: Good call — tentatively holding 7/8 and 7/15 afternoons for enablement. Will attach acceptance checklist template when I send the amendment.
